text:
michelle: FYI kicking off scoping for the long-term routing policy work — want to capture launch criteria + telemetry gates before we lock priorities. link: https://intranet.redwood/roadmap/crossplane-routing (brain dump)

raj: thanks. can we be explicit about tenant isolation levels? customers keep asking for hard boundaries vs soft affinity.

michelle: yep. thinking in three bands: Shadow (no isolation), Affinity (soft routing + best-effort), Quarantine (hard tenant lanes). need SLAs per band, cost delta estimates.

sam: +1 on bands. also need to define fallback behavior if preferred region is overloaded — prefer model-variant fallback or region failover?

dana: for regulated customers we should default to region failover only with explicit opt-in for model-variant fallback. avoids data residency surprises.

eva: can we add a telemetry gate for accuracy/regression when we fallback to quantized variants? we should block automatic fallback if evals show >X% drop.

michelle: yes — propose gating rules: 
```
- perf gate: P50 < 120ms for inference path (affinity), P95 < 300ms for quarantine
- cost gate: incremental cost per 1k qps < $Y for dedicated lanes
- quality gate: end-to-end eval pass rate >= 98% for fallback models
- telemetry gate: prefix cache hit ratio & KV metrics tracked for 30d
```

raj: can we add a rollout policy for canary traffic split + automatic rollback on error-rate or metric drift? example: 1%, 5%, 25%, 100% with 1h observation windows.

michelle: yes. also need audit/logging requirements (KMS, request tracing, token-level cost attribution). I'll add to the docs.

sam: what are the customer-driven asks we should prioritize for Q3? I have a shortlist: GovBank (hard residency), ChatCo (low-latency edge), RetailX (cost-sensitive).

dana: GovBank -> quarantine lanes + HSM. ChatCo -> edge affinity + regional autoscale. RetailX -> optimized batching + quantization profiles.

eva: for the telemetry side: recommend shipping a small opinionated dashboard in Console that surfaces: per-route latency, fallback rate, model-variant switch events, and per-tenant cost delta. :eyes:

ops-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary job created for routing-policy-service v0.4.1 -> will run nightly in staging.

michelle: next steps: (1) owners: raj (policy design), sam (deploy/runbooks), eva (telemetry), dana (security/compliance). (2) draft launch criteria doc and cost model by next Wed. (3) prioritize customer asks into M/HA backlog.

raj: I'll put a strawman doc in the roadmap folder and tag folks. linking initial checklist: https://intranet.redwood/notes/routing-strawman

sam: happy to sync with infra on staging canaries. can we have a quick 30m sync tomorrow? @michelle @raj

michelle: yes — 10:30am PT tomorrow. quick agenda: scope bands, gating thresholds, customer priority mapping.

eva: I'll prep the telemetry queries and a sample dashboard mock.

dana: will list HSM/KMS integration dependencies and compliance blockers.

michelle: awesome. if anyone has other customer asks or hard constraints add them to the doc before EOD. :shipit:
